title: Versioned Ovis consumer fixtures replayed over the binary: explicit-ID layout, typed attach holds, strict targets, subscriptions, reads, records, prompts and authorized stores

cases.summary: The fixture set's pins, generation, adversarial coverage, receipts and the 121-row predicate ledger hold; every happy replay case runs against a fresh server in a fresh root through the binary's connect bridge, binding symbolic identities at run time, and reproduces its normalized receipt.
Every failure replay case, or with --inject only the cases planning that request, is refused with its typed kind and field path while the layout revision, selections and bound history stay unchanged.
